versions.name: Camp Alafia
versions.summary: A primitive Greater Tampa Bay Area Council camp on the Alafia River east of Tampa near Lithia, Florida, with campsites under an oak canopy for weekend and troop camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the community scout-camp-map project. Confirmed as a current Greater Tampa Bay Area Council camp against the council's camp listing (the source's gulfridgecouncil.org link is a dead domain). Coordinates from scout-camp-map (approximate); elevation from the open-meteo DEM. Features not yet surveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a weekend/troop-camping property; features unsurveyed.
